ADD_CONFIGURATION.DESCRIPTION: Define the roles, permissions and sign-in experience for one-click signup links.
ADD_CONFIGURATION.TITLE: Add Configuration
CONFIGURATIONS_LIST.ARCHIVE_SUBTITLE: New links can no longer be generated from "{{name}}". Links already generated from it keep working until they expire or are revoked.
CONFIGURATIONS_LIST.EMPTY_BODY: A configuration decides which roles, permissions and sign-in experience a one-click signup link grants.
CONFIGURATIONS_LIST.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to manage signup link configurations.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.AFTER_ACTIVATI: Sign the invitee in once they set their password
Otherwise they finish on the sign-in screen and type the password they just chose.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.CLIENT_DESCRIP: The application the invitee is signed in to when they open the link.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.DEFAULT_PERMIS: Granted alongside the roles above unless the caller sends its own.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.DEFAULT_ROLES_: Granted to the invitee unless the service generating the link sends its own.
Links from this configuration will grant only what the caller sends
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.EXISTING_PASSW: When on, someone who already has an account must enter their password before an invitation link signs them in.
Existing users must confirm their password
Anyone who can generate links from this configuration will be able to sign in as an existing user without their password.
Existing users won't be asked for a password
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.FORWARDED_PATH: Where inside the application the invitee lands.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.JOIN_URL_DESCR: Where your construct hosts its join screen. Used only to build the link handed back at generation — leave it empty to compose the link yourself.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.MAX_REDEMPTION: Leave empty for single use. 0 = unlimited until the link expires.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.MODE_DESCRIPTI: Your app hosts the join page and receives the session directly. No OIDC client needed.
The invitee signs in through the application you pick below. Choose this if your app uses Blocks-hosted sign-in.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.REDIRECT_URI_C: Choose a client first to list its registered redirect URIs.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.REDIRECT_URI_D: Must be one of this client's registered redirect URIs.
CONFIGURATION_FORM_FIELDS.UNREGISTERED_C: Register as a Blocks OIDC identity provider first
CONFIGURATION_FORM_SCHEMA.DESCRIPTION_MA: Description must be 500 characters or fewer
CONFIGURATION_FORM_SCHEMA.FORWARDED_PATH: Forwarded path must be a relative path starting with /
CONFIGURATION_FORM_SCHEMA.JOIN_URL_INVAL: Join URL must be an absolute https URL with no query or fragment
CONFIGURATION_FORM_SCHEMA.NAME_MAX: Name must be 100 characters or fewer
CONFIGURATION_FORM_SCHEMA.REDIRECT_URI_A: Redirect URI must be an absolute URL
